assets_current_source_unique.name: assets_current_source_unique
assets_current_source_unique.where: "assets"."superseded_at" IS NULL AND "assets"."source_path_key" IS NOT NULL

document_uploads_kind_preview_check.name: document_uploads_kind_preview_check
document_uploads_kind_preview_check.value: ("document_uploads"."kind" = 'copy_pdf' AND "document_uploads"."preview_asset_id" IS NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_key" IS NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_filename" IS NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_bytes" IS NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_content_type" IS NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_upload_id" IS NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_supersedes_asset_id" IS NULL) OR ("document_uploads"."kind" = 'floorplan' AND "document_uploads"."preview_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_key" IS NOT NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_filename" IS NOT NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "document_uploads"."preview_content_type" = 'image/jpeg')

notification_outbox_lease_check.name: notification_outbox_lease_check
notification_outbox_lease_check.value: ("notification_outbox"."status" = 'processing' AND "notification_outbox"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("notification_outbox"."status" != 'processing' AND "notification_outbox"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "notification_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

project_deadline_occurrences_terminal_ch.name: project_deadline_occurrences_terminal_check
project_deadline_occurrences_terminal_ch.value: ("project_deadline_occurrences"."status" = 'pending' AND "project_deadline_occurrences"."terminal_reason" IS NULL AND "project_deadline_occurrences"."fired_at" IS NULL) OR ("project_deadline_occurrences"."status" = 'fired' AND "project_deadline_occurrences"."terminal_reason" IS NULL AND "project_deadline_occurrences"."fired_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("project_deadline_occurrences"."status" IN ('skipped', 'superseded') AND "project_deadline_occurrences"."terminal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "project_deadline_occurrences"."fired_at" IS NULL)

projects_deadline_utc_offset_check.name: projects_deadline_utc_offset_check
projects_deadline_utc_offset_check.value: "projects"."deadline_utc_offset_minutes" IS NULL OR (typeof("projects"."deadline_utc_offset_minutes") = 'integer' AND "projects"."deadline_utc_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -840 AND 840)
